scenicChapters.title: Venus Line
scenicChapters.narrative: Expect company on a summer weekend. Early is better than fast. For 27 km this is Venus Line, a road with a name of its own and a reason for it.

venus-line.story: A 64 km one-way ride from near Chino, about 1 h 06 of riding. On the way it passes Kurumayama and Kirigamine. The highest point is about 1,300 m. A steady touring day rather than a sprint.

scenicChapters.title: Salkammergut Lakes Road
scenicChapters.narrative: Slow enough to look. The surface follows the shoreline, so the corners arrive where the water decided, not where an engineer did. Water arrives beside the road and stays for 41 km. The line follows the shore because there is nowhere else for it to go.

places-historic-centre-of-the-city-of-sa.story: A 126 km round trip from Salzburg - roughly 2 h 10 in the saddle. The stops in between: See, Litzlberg Süd and back through See. The highest point is about 1,050 m.
